purpose: Independent public source leads that could eventually support currently single-publication task types. These are bibliographic and abstract-level leads, not new L0 cards, flight logs, ML evidence, expert endorsements or SFT rows.

scientific_rules: A lead is not an admitted new source cluster until independent document, source-identity, overlapping-literature, rights and event-family checks pass

A real incident described in public literature does not supply real upstream ML findings or logs for DGSI L1; any such fields are newly constructed explicitly SYNTHETIC and must include field-level recipe provenance
For REAL_GOLD the actual separately authorized upstream result/logs/context and expert review are mandatory
No history hit from these leads may enter runtime Context without authentic available_at/verified_at earlier than analysis_cutoff, hardware scope and review status
Proposed task coverage is an authoring hypothesis, not scientific validation or a pre-authorized official split
Keep all references and reviewer notes coordinator-side; target and user input must not inherit the source-event answer
